observations: Two complete headlight assemblies, one left and one right, resting on a tiled floor.
The housing is black plastic with a carbon-fiber textured pattern on the lower section.
The lenses are clear and appear to be in good cosmetic condition.
The internal reflectors and bulb housings are visible but not illuminated.

No brand logos, part numbers, or vehicle model markings are visible on the exterior of the units.
Watermarks 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all photos.
